What people come back for

Five plates guests mention most. Ask for the meze if you want to try a bit of everything.

A tavern, not a concept

Kofini is a family-run tavern on Amathountos Avenue in Agios Tychonas, a few minutes from the hotel strip. Simple Greek-Cypriot food: fish and octopus from the grill, meze, Greek salad, and something cold to drink on a blue-checked table.

Come hungry, come with people you like, and plan for the whole evening.
